main_text.p: impudenter : præeunt passim in Philosophicis viretis credulum illud & sequax ovile: Et sicut Sensus olim adipati cliens Epicuri, ridiculam suos asseclas devolvit in foveam, dum meridiano sole, orientem occidentemque solem, majorem fateri cogit, quia majorem oculi testarentur: ita & hi, pudendis æque, quos ducunt, imo probrosioribus circumveniunt modis; nisi frontem illaqueatis perfricuissetpublicus ille ganeo & corruptor Mos. Seductores hos, hodierno die, reos ago: Amor-Sapientiæ (partes hæ tuæ sunt) sedeto pro tribunali: Assistite, quibus

page.notes: The running head is printed as "ARNOLDI GEULINCX," with a comma. The word "bus" at the foot is the last word of the text line, set right-aligned; it is not a catchword in the strict sense but is recorded as one. Facing page fragments at the right edge are show-through and were not transcribed.
